proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ t i j k p hij hik hjk
  have hall : ∀ l : Fin 3, l = i ∨ l = j ∨ l = k := by decide +revert
  intro h1 h2
  rw [AffineSubspace.mem_perpBisector_iff_dist_eq'] at h1 h2
  rw [AffineSubspace.mem_perpBisector_iff_dist_eq']
  refine ⟨h2.symm.trans h1.symm, ?_⟩
  have hs : p ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range t.points) := by
    haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
    have htop : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range t.points) = ⊤ :=
      t.independent.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_card_eq_finrank_add_one.mpr (by simp [Fact.out (p := Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)])
    rw [htop]; exact AffineSubspace.mem_top ℝ V p
  refine t.eq_circumcenter_of_dist_eq hs (r := dist (t.points i) p) fun l => ?_
  rcases hall l with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · rfl
  · exact h1.symm
  · exact (h1.trans h2).symm
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3) (p : P), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → p ∈ AffineSubspace.perpBisector (t.points i) (t.points j) → p ∈ AffineSubspace.perpBisector (t.points j) (t.points k) → p ∈ AffineSubspace.perpBisector (t.points k) (t.points i) ∧ p = t.circumcenter
